post.description: Typed fallback. The voice path uses WS /ws/voice/{session_id}.
Fallback and tests. The live path is WS /ws/board/{session_id}.
Returns immediately. Progress and results arrive on GET /api/sessions/{id}/events (SSE).

get.description:
Server-Sent Events: evaluator_started, evaluator_done, evaluator_failed, grading_complete.
Replays events that already happened, and closes after grading_complete.
What stood out, what went fine, and where to learn each gap. Shown when the interview ends.

delete.description: Consent: removes every stored row for this session.

get.description: Measured values only. Fields stay null until something was measured.

schema.title: Response Events Api V2 Sessions  Sid  Events Get
Response Lesson Job Api V2 Sessions  Sid  Lesson Jobs Get

evidence_probe_seqs.title: Evidence Probe Seqs
evidence_probe_seqs.description: Probe log steps (seq) that support the score, for process criteria. Show as 'you measured n1, then n2, then swapped D1'.

evidence_quote.title: Evidence Quote
evidence_quote.description: The candidate's own words, checked to appear in their answer.

search_hint.title: Search Hint
search_hint.description: Set when no resource matched. A search term, not a link.

validation_label.title: Validation Label
validation_label.default: Model-reviewed conceptual exercise; no deterministic correctness guarantee

unanswered.title: Unanswered
unanswered.description: Questions the candidate ignored so far.

checked.title: Checked
checked.description: False when the check could not run for the latest answer (model error or timeout), so nothing was judged.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: Skills from the posting. Empty means the patience meter is off.

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: True when the model plan failed and generic questions were used.

memories.title: Memories
memories.description: What PrepCrew remembers about this user from earlier sessions (Backboard). Empty for a first session.

scenario_id.title: Scenario Id
scenario_id.description: Defaults to the session's current scenario.

ProbeRequest.title: ProbeRequest
ProbeRequest.description: Client sends the action only. seq, value and t are always set by the server.

why.title: Why
why.description: What the page covers, from reading it. Not a promise it fixes the gap.

reviewed.title: Reviewed
reviewed.description: True only after a person has reviewed the link and its fit.

verified_on.title: Verified On
verified_on.description: The day the link was opened and its content read.

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: Must be true. Sessions without consent are rejected.

strict.title: Strict
strict.description: False: the patience meter wraps the interview up but never ends it. For demos and testers.

pair_code.title: Pair Code
pair_code.description: Short code the iPad enters to join /ws/board/{session_id}.

opening.title: Opening
opening.description: First interviewer question, interview sessions only.

recalled.title: Recalled
recalled.description: Memories from earlier sessions used for this one. Show as 'Picking up from last time'.

done.title: Done
done.description: True on the turn that ends the interview part; the walkthrough follows.

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: True when the model failed and a planned question was used.

source.title: Source
source.description: model | fallback | fake | scripted. Only 'model' was written by the live model.

ended_early.title: Ended Early
ended_early.description: True when the patience meter ended the interview. The session is then in debrief.

meter.description: Null only when no real model is in use (fake provider).
